actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.role: Leader of Rassemblement National in France
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen is generating massive media coverage by unveiling her ambitious 2027 presidential pension reform platform, promising a legal retirement age between 60 and 62 alongside private capitalization elements. She has also faced intense debate during TV presidential debates over her stance on cutting subsidies for politicized associations and met with diplomatic figures regarding Ukraine.
